```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Monte Carlo seeds in `DSEMr` are derived deterministically from the master seed,
canonical model hash, and replication index. Results are therefore invariant to
worker count and dispatch order across local workstations and HPC clusters.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time")
study <- dsem_monte_carlo(
  model,
  replications = 3,
  generator = function(seed) simulate_dsem(n = 80, ar = 0.5, seed = seed),
  fit_args = list(chains = 2, iter = 200, warmup = 100),
  seed = 2026,
  truth = c("(Intercept)" = 0, lag1_y = 0.5, sigma2 = 1)
)
study$summary
```

For full methodological simulation studies, scale `replications` and chain
lengths and pass `compute = dsem_compute(workers = ..., backend = "psock")`.
